decisions.reason: Building on the firm's established offer allows the firm to assimilate the positive early presentation and improve the product.
The product builds on established knowledge and the quantified launch indicates the firm can interpret demand and learn.
Close to the existing offer with a clear launch statement, so the firm has the knowledge to evaluate and enhance it.
Though only briefly mentioned, it is related to the firm's established offer and the firm can learn from early market response.
Distant from the firm's established offer and showing an early quality problem, so the firm's limited related knowledge makes it hard to assimilate and resolve, favoring exit.
